//: BN-native replacement for DDA base's parametrized_carpets_nest_palette (data/json/mapgen_palettes/common_parameters.json), which BN doesn't ship. MoM's skyscraper/hospital lab break-room and rest-area nests reference both the '=' symbol AND the nest-scoped 'carpet_color_type' parameter (on symbols t/c/the a-with-hook glyph). BN supports palette parameters and scope:nest (see house_w_palette.json), so this ports DDA's definition verbatim; all four carpets are stock BN terrains. Declaring carpet_color_type here silences the 'undefined parameter' check warning and gives the intended random-carpet result instead of always falling back to t_carpet_purple.
